decisions.reason: Its close fit with the firm's existing camera and navigation expertise and strong in-house R&D allow the firm to interpret early results and improve the product, making a drop very unlikely.

The modular camera builds directly on established navigation camera knowledge, and the firm's research base enables it to assimilate early feedback and refine the product, so it is very likely to keep it.

Because this sensor suite extends the firm's established sensor and optics capabilities and benefits from cooperative research, the firm can absorb and act on early market signals, so it will likely keep it.

Although it was only mentioned on the website, the LiDAR sensor is close to the firm's optoelectronic and sensor expertise, and ongoing R&D cooperation gives the firm the capacity to learn and improve it, so drop is unlikely but somewhat higher.
